scope: Two implementation-before contracts for K14's remaining offline vision gaps: local screen OCR/find and explore_app XML-skeleton state graph. Documentation only; no source, tests, dependency, model download, migration, route or device change.

grounding.reference: xuexi/android-agent 7c09f6cd: ocr_screen/ocr_region/find_on_screen via local RapidOCR (XML->OCR fallback), explore_app via XML skeleton hash state graph; both read-only/visual and not action approval.
grounding.v2_current: Android observe/capture/session_captures/objects exist; no OCR engine or dependency is bundled; no explore graph, table or route exists.
grounding.constraints: Existing PNG caps (8192 edge, 16M pixels, 16MiB), password-node exclusion, per-action owner approval, unknown-no-replay and source-erasure barriers remain in force.

D1 provisioning (separate optional package / verified on-demand download / system); default no download
D2 visible surface (offline adapter / owner HTTP / model tool via A); default offline adapter
D3 region and output limits (full/region, pixels, lines/chars/boxes); default authorized screenshot with conservative caps
D4 retention (call only / in-memory short cache / owner-readable result); default call only
D5 failure semantics (explicit android_ocr_unavailable/android_ocr_invalid; no fabricated empty text)
explore_decisions_pending_owner: D0 persistence (memory only / owner-readable JSON / new table via A); default memory only
D1 trigger (owner explicit / agent explicit in an authorized session / none); default offline core only
D2 graph caps (screens/edges/paths/nodes and truncation); default conservative fixed caps with explicit truncated
D3 visible surface (offline adapter / owner HTTP / model tool via A); default offline adapter
D4 failure semantics (explicit android_explore_* or empty graph; never fabricated edges)
contract_boundaries: OCR and explore only consume already-authorized screenshots/observations; no new capture, cloud call, arbitrary path/URL or cross-agent share.
OCR text is untrusted data and never auto-acts; password/sensitive input follows the existing exclusion; logs/audit never contain recognized text or UI bodies.
explore skeleton hashes structural fields only (no text/password values), merges文案 variants, bounds screens/edges, and never fabricates an unobserved target.
No automatic exploration, clicking or input expansion: every action remains under the existing per-action observation binding/approval.
No new table/migration/route/dependency in this batch; D0 undecided keeps memory-only/no-dependency defaults.

validation.grep: checked V2_ANDROID_AUDIT group 2/5, Android observe/capture/objects/session_captures, image caps, password exclusion and the existing Android action-approval contract
